data.name: Link
data.description: The diabolist has an empathic link with her imp to a 1 mile distance. The diabolist can communicate emphatically with the imp, but cannot see through its eyes. Because of the link's limited nature, only general emotions can be shared. The diabolist has the same connection to an item or place that her imp does.
